name: mail-mcp
description: Your own Gmail connector for Claude: read-only MCP server with a guided setup page, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist

OWNER_EMAIL.description: The Google address of the person who owns this connector. Only this address can open the setup page.

SETUP_PASSWORD.description: A long random password to open the setup page the first time. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24` and keep it somewhere safe.

MAIL_KV.description: Storage for settings and mailbox access. Created automatically.
